name: Prophecies
author: Psysonic
description: Inspired by Guild Wars (2005). Armour-violet surfaces under a gold trim, after the original box art, with an engraved display face.

2.0.2: Fixed the preview swatch in Settings showing the colours of whichever theme was applied instead of its own.
2.0.1: No visual change — the gold is now defined in one place instead of being repeated throughout the file.
2.0.0: Rebuilt from a plain recolour into a full theme.
Armour-violet surfaces with a gold trim along the sidebar, player bar and active navigation.
Engraved display face (Cinzel) for headings, plus the wordmark in the sidebar.
Corner filigree on dialogs; the player bar glows faintly while something is playing.
